## Decisions
- `SourcePatch` holds track *references* (not indices) → survives track add/reorder with no command changes needed; a patch to a removed track falls back to default, and undoing the delete restores the same track object so the patch comes back automatically.
- Insert also removes a transition whose *window* covers the insert point, not just one whose cut sits exactly on it — otherwise a split could land inside a transition (slight widening beyond the plan's literal wording).
- Track-header default width raised 168→196px (min 72→96px) to fit the new source-patch gutter alongside the existing 3 editing toggles.
- Clip ▸ Insert already named the generators submenu, so the new menu items are labeled "Insert Edit (,)" / "Overwrite Edit (.)" rather than bare "Insert"/"Overwrite".
